description: Save the business's alert contacts and post-call escalation rules. Read get_operational_settings first: each list you send (notification_phone, notification_email, escalation_rules) replaces the whole saved list, so include the entries to keep. Listed phones get after-call summary texts and escalation texts (one-recipient alerts go to the first phone); listed emails get escalation emails. Saving does not prove delivery.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

dry_run.description: Validate and show the proposed settings without writing.

email_notifications.description: Enable or disable email staff alerts for this business.

escalation_rules.description: Post-call escalation rules checked against each finished call. Replaces the saved rules. Each rule is { id?, when, then, enabled? }.

then.description: Action keys. text_owner (the only one) texts and emails every alert contact above, not only the owner.

when.description: Natural-language trigger, e.g. "Caller needs a same-day callback from the recovery room".

notification_email.description: Email addresses that get escalation emails. Replaces the saved list. Comma-separated string or array.

notification_phone.description: Phones that get alert texts; the first also gets one-recipient alerts. Replaces the saved list. Comma-separated string or array.

sms_notifications.description: Enable or disable SMS staff alerts for this business.

name: configure_staff_alerts
title: Configure Staff Alerts
